[[File:Jared Greenwald (community card).jpg|thumb|right|220px|Jared Greenwald, from the community card ''Jared G''.]]
'''Jared Greenwald''' (GEMP handle '''jetsaredim''')<ref name="gempc-83998">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83998 Registered Players - 128], 8th GEMP Match Play Championship, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2024_GEMPC_Registered_Players_128_forum_t83998 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t83998 2024 GEMPC Registered Players.txt]]</ref> finished '''11th''' in [[2024 Retro League Event 5|Event 5 of the 2024 Retro League]].<ref name="p1432204" /> Greenwald also finished '''#57''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 57).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
